shared_elements: horned ram in profile facing right
large spiral/curled horn rendered with parallel ridges
fleece rendered as dense rows of stylized crescent/comma curls
large almond eye with carved lid and brow
muzzle and mouth line in profile
low-relief animal on a plain ground
justification: Both depict a profile ram with the same distinctive conventions: a tightly curled horn incised with parallel striations sweeping around a large lidded almond eye, and a fleece rendered as regular rows of overlapping comma-shaped curls, with the head turned in the same direction; this is a very specific shared formula rather than a generic 'animal'. The chief difference in content is that A shows a whole procession of two rams with human legs and a hand/arm above them (a leading figure), while B shows only the head and forequarters of one animal without any human element.
